I will list six file paths, one per hop, in the exact order requested: frontend hook, client, proto RPC, handler, store method, and one dialect driver.

`useCreateMemo` calls `memoServiceClient.createMemo` (created in `connect.ts`). That is `MemoService.CreateMemo` in the proto, handled by `APIV1Service.CreateMemo`, which calls `Store.CreateMemo` and then a dialect `DB.CreateMemo` that runs `INSERT INTO memo` (SQLite shown; MySQL/Postgres equivalents are `store/db/mysql/memo.go` and `store/db/postgres/memo.go`). Connect wrapping is in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`.
